{{Quote|I have served the countess all these many years. But I once served another&hellip; My true master was ''Samuro''&hellip; a Jedi Knight.|Z-18|<ref name="NWO" />}}
'''Samuro''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He recognized the threat posed by the [[Energy Vampire|energy vampire]] [[Countess/Legends|Countess]] [[Rajine]] and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] her and the victims of her life-draining powers on a remote [[Rajine's planet|world]]. Samuro used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to raise a [[Force barrier/Legends|barrier]] over the [[Planet/Legends|world]], sacrificing himself to ensure that Rajine and her victims could not leave the planet. [[Time/Legends|Sometime]] before his [[Death/Legends|death]], Samuro recorded a message for Rajine in [[Samuro's Jedi holocron|his Jedi holocron]] and instructed his [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[Z-18]], to give it to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who would eventually arrive on the world. 

Centuries later, during the Clone Wars, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] arrived on Rajine's world. After Windu was captured and imprisoned by Rajine, Z-18 freed the newly arrived Jedi and gave him Samuro's [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. Once Windu confronted Rajine and activated the holocron, Samuro's image and Windu recited an incantation that freed the life-forces of Rajine's [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]]. The victims then turned against the countess and killed her.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Rajine|What is that?|Windu|A message from the past.|Samuro's holocron|Hello, Rajine. If you are listening to this, it means a Jedi has found you. I alone was not strong enough to destroy the evil that you are. I could only contain you. I was only able to trap you here, but not only you&mdash;''all'' of the victims whose life-forces you have drained. ''All'' of their life-forces are trapped here with you. As a Jedi I cannot seek revenge, but all of these lives are quite vengeful. They are ''lost''. Alone I could only trap you, but with another Jedi to speak the words of banishment your doom is sealed&hellip;the words to awaken the lost&hellip;|attr=Rajine, Mace Windu, and Samuro's holocron|src=<ref name="NWO" />}}
[[File:Countess_Rajine_CWA9.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Samuro gave his life to imprison the former Jedi Rajine on a remote world.]]
Samuro was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="NWO" /> He acknowledged the threat that was posed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Countess/Legends|Countess]] [[Rajine]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|125|Samuro}}</ref> who was an [[Energy Vampire|energy vampire]] capable of draining the [[Living Force/Legends|life-forces]] from [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]. Samuro [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] Rajine and her victims in a [[Unidentified city (Rajine's planet)|city]] on a remote [[Rajine's planet|planet]], sacrificing himself by [[Force power/Legends|using]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to raise a [[Force barrier/Legends|barrier]] over the [[Planet/Legends|world]] to ensure that Rajine and her victims could not leave the planet. After his [[Death/Legends|death]], Samuro left behind his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[Z-18]], whom Rajine kept in her service. He also left a [[Samuro's Jedi holocron|Jedi holocron]] with Z-18, instructing the droid to give it to a Jedi who would eventually come to Rajine's world.<ref name="NWO" />

During the Clone Wars several hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] arrived at the [[City/Legends|city]] on Rajine's planet searching for the [[Alpha-2 Squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. He was captured by Rajine and her [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] and imprisoned within the city. However, Z-18 freed Windu and revealed to the Jedi Master that he had served Samuro. The droid gave Windu his master's [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], stating that Samuro had said that Windu would know what to do with it and when. Windu confronted Rajine&mdash;who destroyed Z-18 for his part in freeing Windu&mdash;and activated the holocron, which contained a message from Samuro to Rajine. Samuro's message stated that while he alone was not powerful enough to defeat Rajine, he would be able to defeat her with the assistance of another Jedi. The message revealed that when he and Windu spoke the "[[words of banishment]]," the life-forces of Rajine's victims would be freed from her control. Together, Samuro's image and Windu recited the incantation; the zombies subsequently turned against Rajine and killed her.<ref name="NWO" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He gave his life to imprison Rajine here.|Z-18, to Mace Windu, regarding Samuro|<ref name="NWO" />}}
[[File:Samuro_remains_CWA9.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Samuro's droid, Z-18, shows Mace Windu the Jedi Knight's remains.]]
Samuro was a Jedi Knight who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="NWO" /> He recognized the threat that his fellow Jedi Rajine posed as an energy vampire and imprisoned her on a remote world.<ref name="CSWE" /> Samuro also recognized that he was not powerful enough to destroy her, and he was willing to sacrifice himself in order to trap Rajine and her victims on the planet. In his message to Rajine in his holocron, Samuro stated that as a Jedi he could not seek revenge. However, he was not opposed to allowing Rajine's victims to seek vengeance against her. Samuro had pointed ears and a small nose.<ref name="NWO" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|His Force power has kept her within these walls for eons. He knew that his power would not last forever&hellip;and that one day another Jedi would come.|Z-18, to Mace Windu, regarding Samuro|<ref name="NWO" />}}
When he imprisoned Rajine on a remote world, Samuro used the Force to raise a barrier over the world in order to trap both Rajine and her victims. His Force powers kept Rajine and her zombies contained in the city on the remote world. Before his death, he crafted a Jedi holocron, in which he recorded a message containing an incantation with which to defeat Rajine.<ref name="NWO" />

==Equipment==
Samuro possessed a lightsaber and wore a set of [[Color|brown]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]].<ref name="NWO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Samuro was introduced in the short story ''[[No Way Out]]'', one of four stories compiled in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 9|ninth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperbacks]],<ref name="NWO" /> which was released on [[October 31]], [[2007]].<ref name="Amazon">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/13-623/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Volume-9|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 9}}</ref> The character was drawn by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach|Shawn]] [[Fillbach Brothers|Fillbach]], both of whom also scripted ''No Way Out''.<ref name="NWO" /> Samuro later received an entry in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. The encyclopedia's entries on Z-18 and Samuro refer to him as a Jedi Knight;<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Zee">{{CSWECite|III|365|Z-18}}</ref> however, the entry on Rajine refers to Samuro as a Jedi Master.<ref name="Countess">{{CSWECite|III|75|Rajine, Countess}}</ref>
